tasks.title: Add the store pool: one reader per canonical root with idle eviction

details.goal: One process serves N repositories with one connection and one prepared cache per root, and closes the ones it has not used for a while.
steps: Write the interface and `createStorePool` with the Map keyed by resolved root.
Implement `acquire`, `replace`, `releaseIdle` (returning the closed roots), `closeAll`, `entries`, `size`.

Write `tests/pool.test.ts` with a counting fake opener/closer and an injected clock: same root returns the identical value with `open` called once; three roots are three values; `releaseIdle` before the timeout closes nothing; after it, the idle root is closed, `size` drops, and the next `acquire` reopens; a just-used root survives while a stale one is evicted; `closeAll` twice closes once each; a throwing opener leaves `size === 0` and the retry succeeds.
Assert the module has no timer: `grep -n "setTimeout\|setInterval" src/shared/store/pool.ts` is empty.
